items.title: Nvidia board rejects Huang comeback despite record $116B quarter
items.text: Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations by 5.6% and issued a stronger-than-expected sales forecast, while its board resisted growing calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.

items.title: CFTC halts some Kalshi Trump mention markets over manipulation concerns
items.text: The CFTC stayed Kalshi’s Trump-related mention markets after raising concerns about manipulation risks, giving the platform until Dec. 11 to defend its contracts.

items.title: Widespread outages hit banks, air travel, the NSA and Apple, disrupting seemingly everything
items.text: Major outages showcase the risks of interconnected tech in the age of AI.

items.title: Maple Finance CEO targets up to $15B in assets by the end of 2027
items.text: Sidney Powell aims to reach $15 billion in assets under management by the end of 2027 as the firm looks to expand into tokenized lending and traditional finance.

items.title: Nvidia shares rise on earnings beat, raised outlook despite leadership uncertainty
items.text: Speaking on the earnings call, Chairman Harvey Jones said the board has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO.

items.title: FAA pauses installation of new routers after ground stop
items.text: Problems with the overwhelmed technology led the agency to issue a rare nationwide ground stop on Friday.

items.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
items.text: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.

items.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade
items.text: Brian Armstrong says Coinbase is building payment tools for AI agents and believes bitcoin has hit bottom despite the selloff.

items.title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts
items.text: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission ordered it to stop "mention" contracts involving the U.S. president and is reviewing whether Kalshi followed policy.

items.title: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says he’s open to returning in first statement since resignation
items.text: He said he had seen support from investors and employees and was willing to come back as CEO.

items.title: Jensen Huang kann sich Rückkehr an Nvidia-Spitze vorstellen
items.text: Der wegen einer Affäre mit einer mutmaßlichen chinesischen Spionin zurückgetretene Chef des US-Chipkonzerns Nvidia hat gravierende Fehler eingeräumt. Doch sollte der Vorstand das wünschen, würde er gerne an die Unternehmensspitze zurückkehren.

items.title: Lighter incident exposes risks beyond withdrawal controls
items.text: Crypto platforms need enforceable limits on every route an API key can use to transfer value, including trades, internal transfers and shared pools.

items.title: Druckenmiller says he is short copper, warns of economic weakness in 2027
items.text: The billionaire investor is prioritizing capital preservation and shifting his AI focus from infrastructure to applications.

items.title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
items.text: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

items.title: U.S. Fed Governor Waller pitches keeping central bank at the center of tokenization
items.text: Waller suggested the Federal Reserve could provide trusted rails for emerging innovation tied to tokenized assets and agentic AI.

items.title: Warum eine Konjunkturerholung noch kein Ende der Jobkrise bedeutet
items.text: Aus der Industrie kommen vorsichtige Zeichen der Zuversicht. Trotzdem könnte der Stellenabbau Experten zufolge erst einmal weitergehen. Warum ein Schub für den Arbeitsmarkt auf sich warten lässt. Von Alina Leimbach.

items.title: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
items.text: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.

items.title: Analysis: The Fed's chairman sees an AI revolution coming. Now he has to figure out what it means
items.text: Kevin Warsh sees AI at a turning point. He faces tough questions on jobs and interest rates.

items.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
items.text: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

items.title: St. Louis Fed's Musalem says four more rate hikes may be needed in coming months
items.text: The forecast represents one of the most hawkish views among policymakers.

items.title: Marktbericht: Deutsche-Bank-Aktien nach neuen Vorwürfen unter Druck
items.text: Aktien der Deutschen Bank fallen deutlich. Grund dafür ist ein Datenleck, das Millionen interner Papiere offengelegt haben soll, in denen unter anderem von Geldwäsche die Rede ist. Das Bankhaus wiegelt ab.

items.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
items.text: In addition to that broader estimate, independent audits have uncovered hundreds of separate compatibility problems, with core developers set to reconsider the changes Thursday.

items.title: EU-Kommission verdoppelt Prognose für Deutschland
items.text: Die EU-Kommission hat ihre Konjunkturprognose für Deutschland stark angehoben. Grund ist das kräftige Plus bei den Exporten. Die Inflation dürfte jedoch hartnäckig bleiben.

items.title: Datenleck: Interne Dokumente belasten die Deutsche Bank
items.text: Die Schatten der Vergangenheit holen die Deutsche Bank erneut ein. Informationen aus einem Datenleck offenbaren fragwürdige Geschäftspraktiken und mutmaßliche Probleme bei den Kontrollen beim größten deutschen Geldhaus.

items.title: US-Regierung verhängt neue Exportbeschränkungen für KI-Chips
items.text: Die US-Regierung verschärft ihre Ausfuhrregeln für hochmoderne KI-Chips und will damit nach dem Nvidia-Skandal Schlupflöcher nach China schließen. Die Tech-Aktien in den USA sackten nach der Bekanntgabe ab.

items.title: Nach Huang-Affäre: Bald alles neu in der KI-Chipindustrie?
items.text: Konkurrenten wie AMD oder Qualcomm reiben sich nach dem Abgang von Huang als CEO bei Nvidia schon die Hände. Was ist dran am möglichen Umbruch der Chip-Branche - und wie viel hat er tatsächlich mit dem Abtritt Huangs zu tun? Von R. Spiegelhauer.

items.title: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite
items.text: Energy subsidies for households had reportedly expired in September, exposing the economy to the higher energy prices brought about by the Iran war.
